summary: Frontend-only validation of the new confirm-before-submit overlay in My Orders -> order detail form for recharge info. Signed in as member (user_3Kc4MFu2DHwZuy8itp5vS09nzaL = tester+clerk_test@shop.com) by minting a Clerk sign_in_token via Backend API and completing signIn.create({strategy:'ticket'}) + setActive in-page (Clerk dev instance). Reset existing paid order bd88b987-8c29-4487-8104-f159a52c725c (抖音抖幣充值, pid=7814, required field 抖音帐号) to info_submitted=false and tested on mobile viewport 390x844. Discovered DOM field name is simplified '抖音帐号' (Chinese locale normalises the traditional-form product.delivery_fields.name '抖音帳號'); testids on both the input and overlay row use the same string so pairing is consistent. Results: (A) submit with empty required field -> toast '请填写「抖音帐号」', data-testid order-info-confirm is NOT rendered, zero POST requests captured to /orders/{id}/info. (B) fill '6781777' then click order-info-submit -> order-info-confirm overlay appears; order-info-confirm-7814-抖音帐号 inner text exactly '6781777'; sibling label text contains '抖音帐号'. (C) click order-info-confirm-back -> overlay removed from DOM, input value still '6781777', zero POSTs. (D) submit again -> overlay -> click order-info-confirm-ok -> POST /api/orders/bd88b987.../info returns 200, success toast '充值资料已提交，等待人工充值', overlay gone, order-info-locked panel visible with existing field summary. No console/page errors during the flow (only expected Clerk dev-keys warning and Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warning that is pre-existing and unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: MyOrders.jsx InfoConfirm (line ~79): the per-row label element is `<div class="text-[11px]...">` — in the tester helper I had to use parent.querySelector('div') to read it; adding e.g. data-testid=`order-info-confirm-label-${pid}-${f.name}` would make downstream automated verification of the label text robust (currently only the value has a testid).

MyOrders.jsx line 82: the confirm overlay is dismissible by clicking the dim backdrop (onClick={onBack} on the outer fixed inset-0 div). This is undocumented in the spec and silently acts like 返回修改. If product wants the user to always use an explicit button, drop the backdrop onClick; otherwise fine.

MyOrders.jsx line 35: validation message uses raw `f.name` from server data (e.g. '抖音帐号') rather than any user-visible label mapping — fine today but if products ever store internal field codes as `name`, the toast would surface a dev-only code. Consider using f.label || f.name consistently.

MyOrders.jsx line 50: when profile is incomplete, ContactInfoDialog is returned INSIDE the form branch which also owns the open-state; after saving profile, the user sees nothing until re-opening the sheet because `setOpen(false)` is passed to onClose. Not touched by this feature but worth a follow-up.

Toast selector note for next agents: the app renders sonner toasts with [data-sonner-toast]; the error flow for required-field validation does NOT render an overlay, so always assert on overlay absence + toast content.
test_credentials: Used Clerk Backend API sign_in_tokens with user_id=user_3Kc4MFu2DHwZuy8itp5vS09nzaL (member tester+clerk_test@shop.com) + helper /app/tests/mint_token.py. No credential changes.
seed_data_creation: Reused and reset existing paid order id=bd88b987-8c29-4487-8104-f159a52c725c (order_no GT261013BBE72A, user tester) back to info_submitted=false between runs via a direct motor update; after the final test the order ends in status='paid' + info_submitted=true + delivery_info={'7814': {'抖音帐号':'6781777'}} (will be picked up by human recharge flow). Main agent can leave as-is or reset again as needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To authenticate against this Clerk dev instance from Playwright, DO NOT drive the UI AuthModal (bot-protected). Instead: (1) POST https://api.clerk.com/v1/sign_in_tokens with Authorization: Bearer $CLERK_SECRET_KEY and User-Agent set, body {user_id, expires_in_seconds}; (2) in the page, after `window.Clerk.loaded`, call `await window.Clerk.client.signIn.create({strategy:'ticket', ticket})` then `await window.Clerk.setActive({session: si.createdSessionId})`. This yields a 'complete' sign-in and useApi() will send Authorization: Bearer. For order detail deep-link use /orders?order=<id> which auto-opens the SheetContent. Field testids inside the form use raw server field names — these are normalised to Simplified Chinese on this zh-CN locale (traditional '抖音帳號' becomes '抖音帐号'); always introspect the actual data-testid rather than hard-code the field name. Reset order recharge state between runs via `db.orders.update_one({id:...},{\$set:{delivery_info:{}, info_submitted:false, info_rejected:false, status:'paid'}, \$unset:{info_submitted_at:'', info_reject_reason:''}})`.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. The confirm-before-submit overlay (data-testid order-info-confirm with per-row data-testid order-info-confirm-<pid>-<fieldname>, buttons order-info-confirm-back / order-info-confirm-ok) is implemented correctly in /app/frontend/src/pages/MyOrders.jsx (OrderInfoForm.submit guard + InfoConfirm component) and is wired to call POST /api/orders/{order_id}/info only on explicit 確認無誤，提交.
